map.根据导管类型和管腔容量，计算冲管和封管的生理盐水/肝素液用量。: Computes saline/heparin flush and lock volumes by catheter type and lumen capacity.
map.单管腔冲管量 = 导管容积 + 追加量（约 2 mL）；封管量 = 导管容积 ×: Single-lumen flush = lumen volume + add-on (~2 mL); lock = lumen volume x 1.2; total flush = single x lumen count; heparin units = total lock (mL) x concentration (U/mL, usually 10 or 100); use positive-pressure pulsatile flush and clamp while pushing.
map.3. 正压封管：边推注边退针，避免血液回流: 3. Positive-pressure lock: push while withdrawing to avoid reflux
map.4. 使用前需抽回血确认通畅，再冲管: 4. Aspirate blood return before use, then flush
map.5. 每次输液前、后均需冲管: 5. Flush before and after each infusion
map.6. 输注血液、高营养液后需增加冲管量: 6. Increase flush after blood or TPN
map.注意：严格无菌操作，冲管遇阻力不可强行推注，应检查导管是否打折或血栓。肝素使用需: Note: strict asepsis; never force a resistant flush-check for kinking or clot. Heparin needs coagulation assessment.
map.输液前后用≥10 ml 生理盐水脉冲式冲管，防止配伍沉淀。: Before/after infusion use >=10 mL saline pulsatile flush to prevent precipitate.
map.治疗间歇封管：肝素液 0–10 U/ml 或生理盐水（按导管与医嘱），正压封管。: Interim lock: heparin 0-10 U/mL or saline (per catheter and order), positive pressure.
map.输血或脂肪乳后增加冲管量，避免管腔残留。: Increase flush after blood or lipid emulsion to avoid lumen residue.
map.输入导管=PICC、间歇期，工具给封管液 0–10 U/ml 肝素、容积 2–3: Input catheter=PICC, interim; tool gives heparin 0-10 U/mL, volume 2-3 mL positive lock, matching the care manual.
map.本工具能替代维护操作规程吗？: Can this tool replace the care protocol?
map.不能，仅作剂量核对，操作以静脉治疗护理规范与医嘱为准。: No; it only checks dose. Procedure follows IV-therapy standards and orders.
map.冲管阻力大怎么办？: What if flush resistance is high?
map.禁止暴力冲管，排查血栓或堵管，必要时造影或请专科处理。: Never force; rule out clot or occlusion; image or consult if needed.
map.肝素过敏患者如何封管？: How to lock for heparin-allergic patients?
map.改用生理盐水封管或遵医嘱用枸橼酸钠，禁用肝素。: Use saline lock or citrate per order; heparin is contraindicated.
map.按导管类型与封管液给出冲管封管剂量频次，规范静脉治疗维护。: Gives flush/lock dose and frequency by catheter and solution to standardize IV care.
